sections.title: Songs
sections.note: Conduct with the Wind Waker: the arrows are the C-Stick (● is the middle). Each song also needs its time signature: 3/4, 4/4 or 6/4.

items.name: Wind's Requiem
items.howTo: Read the stone tablet by the Wind Waker symbol on Dragon Roost Island, on the first visit.
items.notes: ▲ ◀ ▶. Changes the wind's direction. The most-used song on the GameCube; Wind Waker HD's Swift Sail does the same job for sailing.

items.name: Ballad of Gales
items.howTo: Shoot Cyclos with arrows inside one of his cyclones (near Mother and Child Isles, Northern Triangle Island or Shark Island) until he gives up.
items.notes: ▼ ▶ ◀ ▲. Warps Link to one of the cyclone points on the Great Sea. Needs the Hero's Bow. Photograph Cyclos first for the Nintendo Gallery.

items.name: Command Melody
items.howTo: Learned on a Wind Waker symbol inside the Tower of the Gods.
items.notes: ◀ ● ▶ ●. Takes control of statues, and of Medli and Makar in their temples.

items.name: Earth God's Lyric
items.howTo: Learned from Laruto's spirit at the Earth Temple's entrance on Headstone Island; play it to Medli to wake her as the Earth Sage.
items.notes: ▼ ▼ ● ▶ ◀ ●. Wakes Medli; opens the way in the Earth Temple.

items.name: Wind God's Aria
items.howTo: Learned from Fado's spirit at the Wind Temple's entrance on Gale Isle; play it to Makar to wake him as the Wind Sage.
items.notes: ▲ ▲ ▼ ▶ ◀ ▶. Wakes Makar; opens the way in the Wind Temple.

items.name: Song of Passing
items.howTo: Show Tott, the dancing man on Windfall Island, the Wind Waker and copy his dance.
items.notes: ▶ ◀ ▼. Turns day to night and night to day. The only optional song; handy for the night-only quests and the Nintendo Gallery.
